title: Elon Musk, Uber co-founder join calls to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia chief
summary: Elon Musk and an Uber co-founder were among more than 158,000 signatories by Sunday demanding Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia chief pending an independent investigation. Huang resigned Thursday after revelations of two extramarital affairs, one with a subordinate and another with a woman accused of spying for China, ending his 33-year tenure.
